articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump stated he is open to meeting incoming Democratic Senator Abdul El-Sayed of Michigan to discuss a national healthcare programme. While Trump praised the branding of a mock Trumpcare card shared online, no meeting date is set and he has not endorsed the proposal as Democrats prepare to take control of the US Congress in January.
articles.description: Experts tell Al Jazeera they are sceptical that Trump would back Medicare for All, a proposal for national healthcare.

articles.headline: Deadly truck fire is latest of Egypt’s transport disasters
articles.title: Deadly truck fire is latest of Egypt’s transport disasters
articles.description: Dozens were killed and injured when a truck carrying gas cylinders caught fire near Cairo’s Ring Road.

articles.headline: Andy Taylor, original guitarist for English new wave band Duran Duran, dies
articles.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
articles.summary: Andy Taylor, founding guitarist of the 1980s English new wave group Duran Duran, has died at age sixty-five. His family and bandmates confirmed the passing in a joint statement, praising his musical impact. The artist had publicly disclosed in November 2022 that he was living with stage four metastatic prostate cancer during the band's Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction.
articles.description: The band’s imperial stage occurred with a trio of hit albums between 1981 and 1983, with such dance-floor barnburners as ‘Girls on Film’ and ‘Union of the Snake’ and the moody ballads ‘The Chauffeur’ and ‘Save a Prayer’

articles.headline: Donyell Malen penalty secures Roma a draw against Paris Saint-Germain
articles.title: Malen and Roma deny injury-hit PSG in Champions League draw
articles.summary: Donyell Malen converted a late penalty to earn Roma a two-all draw against Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League on Wednesday at the Parc des Princes. The result halted the reigning champions' twelve-match winning run and their perfect record in this season's league phase. Mario Hermoso opened the scoring for Roma before Illia Zabarnyi and Ousmane Dembele scored for Paris Saint-Germain.
articles.description: Champions League holders Paris Saint-Germain held to 2-2 draw by Roma as injury-ravaged squad struggle.

articles.headline: Manchester United draw two-two with Sporting Lisbon in Champions League
articles.title: Man United denied at Sporting as referee overshadows Fernandes double
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino experienced a frustrating first match in charge of Manchester United on Wednesday as his side drew two-two against Sporting Lisbon in the Champions League. Bruno Fernandes scored twice against his former club, while Luis Suarez netted a brace for the hosts, aided by a decisive goalkeeping error from Senne Lammens. Youri Tielemans was also sent off late in the game.
articles.description: Bruno Fernandes nets twice in Lisbon, but referee's decisions in spotlight as Mauricio Pochettino denied first win.

articles.headline: Google files patent for custom artificial intelligence video streaming feeds
articles.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
articles.summary: Google recently filed a patent for a system called My Channel, which aims to generate personalized entertainment using demographic data and large language models. Although the patent was rejected, the proposed technology would create tailored films featuring users as the main characters by utilizing their viewing history, location data, and contextual inputs from various connected streaming platforms.
articles.description: Last year, Google filed a patent for a system called My Channel that's designed to create feeds filled with personalized, AI-generated videos and advertisements based on information the company knows about its users. The patent has been rejected, but unfortunately, Google might appeal or resubmit an amended version, and we could see this monstrosity come […]

articles.headline: North Korea orders Swiss diplomatic representative to leave the country
articles.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
articles.summary: North Korea ordered Switzerland's diplomatic representative to depart within forty-eight hours and closed the office following a dispute over Swiss sanctions targeting the Songdowon international children's camp. State media condemned the sanctions as a hostile act linked to allegations involving Ukrainian children. Swiss authorities stated that bilateral relations will continue through embassies in Bern and Beijing despite the diplomatic fallout.
articles.description: Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern, and its own embassy in Beijing.

articles.headline: Supreme Court signals intent to stay high court order on civic polls
articles.title: Supreme Court suggests referring KMC delimitation case back to High Court for fresh look
articles.summary: The Supreme Court indicated it is inclined to stay a Calcutta High Court order that deferred municipal elections in Kolkata pending a challenge on ward delimitation. Justices emphasized that pending elections should not be postponed unreasonably. The Bench asked Solicitor General Tushar Mehta to seek instructions on the matter before November thirty.
articles.description: Supreme Court lists the case for hearing on November 30 after lawyers seek time to get instructions on the suggestion from the court

articles.headline: United States Department of Education investigates Virginia school closures
articles.title: US Education Department probes Virginia schools after sexual abuse scandal
articles.summary: The United States Department of Education announced an investigation and funding freeze targeting an Albemarle County district after local authorities shut down twenty-nine schools. Secretary Linda McMahon confirmed the enforcement action following revelations that over five hundred staff members missed routine background checks, though officials emphasized none are suspected of child abuse.
articles.description: Virginia schools face scrutiny after revelations of abuse and widespread failures in mandatory staff background checks.

articles.headline: Bharti Airtel invests twelve billion rupees in Assam data centres
articles.title: Airtel to invest ₹1,200 cr in 3 data centers in Assam
articles.summary: Telecommunications firm Bharti Airtel announced plans to invest approximately twelve billion rupees to construct three data centres across Assam. The initiative includes a seven-billion-rupee facility in Guwahati alongside projects in Jorhat and Silchar. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma noted that the development highlights growing investor confidence and will expand digital infrastructure in the region.
articles.description: All three data centers,Guwahati, Jorhat and Silchar, are expected to be in place by 2028

articles.headline: What’s behind Europe’s protests?
articles.title: What’s behind Europe’s protests?
articles.description: Increase in protests and industrial disputes across EU and UK.

articles.headline: VCK leader urges Tamil Nadu commission to enact anti-honour killing law
articles.title: Right to choose a partner is an aspect of constitutional freedom, not a privilege granted by a family, caste or community: Thirumavalavan
articles.summary: Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi founder and Chidambaram Member of Parliament Thol. Thirumavalavan submitted a memorandum to the Tamil Nadu Commission for the Prevention of Honour Killings, asserting that choosing a partner is a constitutional freedom. He urged the panel to recommend a comprehensive State law against honour crimes, establish a framework for mob violence accountability, and mandate official protection for couples.

articles.headline: Migrant wrongly deported by Trump leaves US for Spain
articles.title: Migrant wrongly deported by Trump leaves US for Spain
articles.description: Kilmar Abrego Garcia has arrived in Spain with his wife after a 20-month legal battle with the Trump administration.

articles.headline: Moment Nasa spacecraft hit asteroid - and what happened next
articles.title: Moment Nasa spacecraft hit asteroid - and what happened next
articles.description: The crash was "like something out of a disaster movie", the BBC's science editor Rebecca Morelle says.

articles.headline: Elderly man with Alzheimer’s rescued after 11 days in Amazon jungle
articles.title: Elderly man with Alzheimer’s rescued after 11 days in Amazon jungle
articles.description: A 74-year-old man with Alzheimer's has been found alive after missing for 11 days in Brazil's Amazon rainforest.

articles.headline: US Army destroys volatile lead azide explosives during Iowa military operation
articles.title: US Army declares Iowa lead azide detonation ‘tremendously successful’
articles.summary: United States Army officials confirmed the successful destruction of approximately 4,500 kilograms of deteriorating lead azide at an Iowa military base after a controlled detonation. Major General Eric Shirley stated the mission exceeded expectations with zero infrastructure damage. While Environmental Protection Agency sensors initially detected no airborne lead, independent experts emphasised the ongoing need to monitor potential environmental breakdown products and toxic risks.
articles.description: Army hails Iowa's lead azide disposal operation as some experts warn of potentially hidden toxins.

articles.headline: Six people killed in plane crash off the Mississippi coast
articles.title: Two children among six dead after plane crash off Mississippi coast
articles.summary: Six individuals, including two children aged eight and ten, died after a Cessna 210 aircraft crashed into the Gulf of Mexico off the coast of Mississippi on Tuesday. According to the United States Coast Guard, divers recovered the bodies from the fuselage after air traffic control lost contact with the flight traveling from New Orleans to Fort Myers.
articles.description: Divers found the bodies of three adult, one teenager aged 16, and two boys, aged 12 and 10, in the wreckage.

articles.headline: Saudi-led coalition launches renewed military strikes on Hodeidah port in Yemen
articles.title: Could renewed strikes on Hodeidah port worsen Yemen’s humanitarian crisis?
articles.summary: The Saudi-led coalition conducted new attacks against Houthi targets at Yemen's vital Hodeidah port on Wednesday. The escalation responds to recent Houthi territorial gains and missile attacks on Saudi Arabia. Handing critical commercial imports and humanitarian aid, the port has faced extensive damage from a decade of conflict and previous foreign military interventions.
articles.description: Disruptions at Yemen's largest seaport could exacerbate hardships for millions of Yemenis, aid experts warn.

articles.headline: British military relocates aircraft to hangars to guard against drone attacks
articles.title: UK military ‘moving aircraft to hangars in case of drone attacks’
articles.summary: Britain's Ministry of Defence is reportedly moving Royal Air Force planes into hangars and hardened shelters overnight alongside installing anti-drone nets. Security precautions follow warnings regarding potential sabotage and drone threats from foreign actors. The ministry noted it constantly adapts to counter emerging risks while investing heavily to strengthen infrastructure protection across critical military sites.
articles.description: Experts say the move is a 'logical response' if there is intelligence suggesting a likely drone threat.

articles.headline: Jammu and Kashmir police target locals operating from Pakistan-administered territory
articles.title: J&K Police, after killing last local LeT recruit, shift focus on locals operating from PoK; properties of seven attached
articles.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Police attached properties belonging to seven individuals based in Pakistan-administered regions following the elimination of the final local Lashkar-e-Taiba recruit. Directed by police chief Nalin Prabhat under anti-terror legislation, authorities seized land linked to suspects who allegedly crossed the border during the nineteen nineties to support militant activities within the region.
articles.description: The police suspect that the accused crossed the Line of Control into Pakistan in the 1990s for arms and ammunition training and subsequently remained associated with efforts to revive terrorist activities in the region

articles.headline: Surgeons remove large pancreatic stones through keyhole procedure
articles.title: Large-sized pancreatic stones removed via keyhole surgery
articles.summary: Surgeons at GEM Hospital removed large pancreatic stones measuring up to three centimeters from a forty-one-year-old male patient using laparoscopic surgery. Led by P. Senthilnathan, the medical team extracted the calculi without abdominal scars or stitches, providing relief to the patient who suffered from acute-on-chronic calcific pancreatitis and secondary diabetes.

articles.headline: Vehicle fire on Cairo ring road leaves thirty people dead and twenty-five injured
articles.title: At least 30 killed in Egypt vehicle fire, health ministry says
articles.summary: At least thirty people died and twenty-five others sustained injuries when a petroleum truck overturned and caught fire above a tunnel in Giza's Imbaba district on Wednesday. Egypt's public prosecutor launched an official investigation into the crash, ordering DNA collection from victims. Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly directed the state to cover all medical expenses for the injured.
articles.description: An additional 15 were injured in blaze after vehicle carrying petroleum products flipped on a major road.

articles.headline: Women commission urges special investigation into illegal egg racket
articles.title: Women’s Commission urges Telangana Governor to recommend special investigation into illegal oocyte racket
articles.summary: The Telangana State Women’s Commission urged Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla to recommend a special investigation into an illegal oocyte collection racket busted in Hyderabad. Chairperson Nerella Sharada briefed the Governor on the exploitation of vulnerable women brought from multiple states, highlighting legal loopholes in the Assisted Reproductive Technology Act.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu officials association seeks fair inquiry into harassment complaint
articles.title: ‘Ensure fair inquiry into complaint by IAS officer’
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu Indian Administrative Service Officers Association submitted a representation to Chief Secretary M. Sai Kumar requesting a fair inquiry into a sexual harassment complaint involving a woman officer. Police registered a first information report against Kallakurichi Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam Member of Legislative Assembly C. Arul Vignesh, while an internal complaints committee was formed.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu opposes Cauvery water release decision at CWMA meeting
articles.title: T.N. opposes ad hoc release of only 2,000 cusecs at Biligundlu
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu government registered its dissent at the 62nd meeting of the Cauvery Water Management Authority in New Delhi on Wednesday. Officials opposed a Cauvery Water Regulation Committee decision directing Karnataka to release only two thousand cusecs at Biligundlu for sixteen days, arguing that deficit years require pro-rata reductions based on yield assessment standards.

articles.headline: Colombian security forces storm Cartagena supermarket to rescue hostages
articles.title: Colombian police storm supermarket to free 76 held hostage for 17 hours
articles.summary: Colombian security forces freed approximately 20 shoppers and employees held hostage for 17 hours at a supermarket in Cartagena. Gunmen stormed the building on Tuesday following a failed robbery of an armoured car. President Abelardo de la Espriella authorized special forces to launch a rescue operation using stun grenades, resulting in the death of one gunman and the safe release of the remaining captives.
articles.description: One gunman was killed after what the country's president described as a robbery of a cash-laden armoured car gone wrong.

articles.headline: Calcutta High Court defers final hearing on Great Nicobar Island project petitions
articles.title: Great Nicobar Island project: Final Calcutta High Court hearing deferred as Centre seeks to file affidavit, objections
articles.summary: The Calcutta High Court postponed its final hearing regarding forest rights violations for the Great Nicobar Island project on Wednesday after the Centre requested additional time to submit new affidavits. Presided over by Chief Justice Ravindra Vithalrao Ghuge, the bench rescheduled proceedings for January 2027 to address ongoing legal disputes over tribal rights and administrative compliance.
articles.description: Centre argues that the FRA is not implemented in the A&NI, objects to some petitions claiming that they should be heard by the NGT or SC; next hearing posted for January 13, 2027; court to hear Attorney General of India on January 22

articles.headline: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu pledges security improvements at Maiduguri rally
articles.title: Nigeria’s Tinubu pledges to bring peace to rebellion-hit border region
articles.summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu promised supporters in Maiduguri on Wednesday that security forces would restore peace to the rebellion-hit border region ahead of the January 16 presidential election. Facing criticism over ongoing terrorism and kidnapping, Tinubu urged rebel fighters to surrender while security analysts noted improved accessibility across Borno State local governments.
articles.description: Tinubu is under pressure to convince voters that military operations in the country's northeast will deliver security.

articles.headline: Congress leader criticises Samajwadi Party over seat-sharing disputes
articles.title: SP, Congress seat-sharing talks turn bumpy in U.P., as Akhilesh declares candidates for five seats
articles.summary: Congress Uttar Pradesh Working Committee chief Imran Masood criticised the Samajwadi Party on Wednesday after candidates were announced for five seats while seat-sharing talks for the upcoming Assembly polls were ongoing. Masood stated that the party is not begging and will consult leadership on whether to continue discussions following the inconclusive meeting at Pramod Tiwari's Delhi residence.
articles.description: Congress leaders slammed the decision to make a unilateral announcement while talks are still underway; reject SP’s initial 26-seat proposal; SP leaders say Congress must set aside ego, understand realities

articles.headline: Kremlin rejects former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson's Western troop proposal
articles.title: Kremlin rejects ex-U.K. PM Johnson's call for a token Western force in Ukraine as unacceptable
articles.summary: The Kremlin rejected former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson's proposal to deploy a token Western military force to Ukraine, calling any foreign contingent unacceptable on Wednesday. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov criticized the suggestion following Johnson's remarks to Sky News advocating for logistical support from a coalition of willing nations.
articles.description: Russian officials have repeatedly warned that any Western troops ​deployed to Ukraine would be legitimate targets for Russian forces

articles.headline: Oil tankers strike naval mines in Strait of Hormuz
articles.title: Iran says ships hit mines in Hormuz, warns vessels to coordinate passage
articles.summary: Two oil tankers struck naval mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on November 25, 2026, after attempting to transit an unauthorized route. Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy reported the incident while the Iranian military announced enhanced surveillance systems, as Tehran maintains it will not restore normal shipping until United States demands are met.
articles.description: The statement said the vessels ‌had been attempting to transit ‌an ⁠unauthorised route through the ⁠waterway

articles.headline: Ecuador and United States review joint military operations
articles.title: Ecuador and US review joint military operations, official says
articles.summary: Ecuador and the United States reviewed bilateral security operations following a temporary pause prompted by human rights concerns over a September 23 raid that killed Carlos German Munoz Jara. Interior Minister John Reimberg confirmed that recent discussions in Quito between US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and President Daniel Noboa established a new cooperative action plan.
articles.description: Joint military efforts have been paused as the US investigates a lethal operation carried out by Ecuador.

articles.headline: European spacecraft arrives at asteroid four years after Nasa impact test
articles.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
articles.summary: The European Space Agency mission named Hera has arrived at the asteroid system comprising Didymos and Dimorphos to investigate the aftermath of Nasa's Dart spacecraft impact from 2022. Scientists hope to assess changes to the smaller rock's orbit and structure to improve planetary defense strategies against potential future hazards threatening Earth.
articles.description: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

articles.headline: India defeats Japan four to zero to sweep Women's Asian Champions Trophy
articles.title: Women’s Asian Champions Trophy: India thrashes Japan to sweep the league stage
articles.summary: The Indian team secured a four-zero victory over Japan on Wednesday to complete an undefeated league stage in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy. Lalremsiami, Deepika, and Neha scored goals during the match despite chilly conditions and thick smog. The win propelled India to fourth in the International Hockey Federation rankings ahead of their semifinal match against Malaysia.

articles.headline: Maduro turns 64 behind bars, son leads celebrations in Caracas
articles.title: Maduro turns 64 behind bars, son leads celebrations in Caracas
articles.description: Nicolas Maduro’s son led birthday celebrations in Caracas as the abducted former Venezuelan president turned 64

articles.headline: SEBI revises KYC framework to simplify client onboarding
articles.title: SEBI eases KYC norms, simplifies client onboarding
articles.summary: Market regulator SEBI introduced revisions to the Know Your Customer framework on November 25, 2026, to centralize supplementary client information and reduce documentation duplication. Set to take effect on December 24, the updated guidelines ease address requirements for certain foreign residents and streamline verification procedures across financial market intermediaries.
articles.description: SEBI said that verification of a client's mobile number will be optional for an intermediary if the number available in the KRA system has already been verified and tagged as Aadhaar-seeded

articles.headline: India prepares for second Test against New Zealand in Christchurch
articles.title: IND vs NZ second Test: Eyeing WTC finals, India hopes to replicate heroics and sign off with Test victory
articles.summary: The Indian Test squad rested on Wednesday in Christchurch ahead of the series finale against New Zealand starting Friday at Hagley Oval. Seeking a series victory after 17 years and keeping World Test Championship final hopes alive, the visitors are expected to maintain their combination, while New Zealand recalled Matt Fisher to replace injured backup pacer Blair Tickner.
articles.description: The memories of those back-to-back T20I victories at Hagley Oval will linger as India’s Test contingent looks to make its own mark over the next week

articles.headline: Switzerland closes Pyongyang office after North Korea demands expulsion
articles.title: Switzerland forced to close office in North Korea over sanctions feud
articles.summary: The Swiss government expressed regret after North Korea ordered the head of the Swiss diplomatic office in Pyongyang to leave within forty-eight hours. The expulsion follows a sanctions dispute involving a children camp. Switzerland defended its measures as part of an independent universalist foreign policy aimed at maintaining dialogue channels despite differences between the two nations.
articles.description: The closure came after North Korea condemned Switzerland for adding a children’s camp to its sanctions list.

articles.headline: Colombian forces rescue all hostages after supermarket siege
articles.title: Colombian forces rescue all hostages after supermarket siege
articles.description: All hostages have been rescued by Colombian forces after a 17-hour siege in Cartagena supermarket.

articles.headline: Donald Trump’s investment portfolios traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year
articles.title: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show
articles.summary: Financial disclosures revealed that United States President Donald Trump’s investment portfolios bought and sold Nvidia shares at least 44 times between January and September. The trading activity precedes recent market volatility sparked by the resignation and subsequent reinstatement of Chief Executive Jensen Huang, a return facilitated partly by intervention from the United States government.
articles.description: A review of the US president's financial disclosures shows Donald Trump's investment portfolios have regularly traded shares in the tech giant.

articles.headline: Seventeen-year-old student shoots two school staff members in Kragujevac
articles.title: Why are school shootings continuing to shake the Balkans?
articles.summary: A seventeen-year-old student shot and wounded two female staff members at the First Technical School in Kragujevac during the first class of the day. Police officers disarmed and arrested the suspect, while a juvenile judge ordered a thirty-day detention. The incident renewed regional concerns over firearms availability, online warning signs, and the implementation of effective preventive security measures across schools.
articles.description: A shooting in Serbia has renewed concerns over firearm access, online warning signs and failures to prevent violence.

articles.headline: Why did Israel arrest human rights defender Ghassan Al Najjar?
articles.title: Why did Israel arrest human rights defender Ghassan Al Najjar?
articles.description: Palestinian farmer and human rights defender Ghassan Najjar was arrested by Israeli forces.

articles.headline: Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam sets six thousand crore cost target
articles.title: Three months into the job, Air India CEO Tewolde sets ₹6,000 crore cost-saving target, looks to boost revenues
articles.summary: Air India Chief Executive Officer Tewolde Gebremariam announced an ambitious target of six thousand crore rupees in cost savings during a town hall meeting. The carrier aims for a twenty percent reduction in non-fuel expenses and five percent in fuel costs after posting a significant loss in the twenty twenty-six fiscal year. The financial turnaround strategy also includes expanding cargo operations and launching packaged holiday services.
articles.description: Tewolde Gebremariam said Air India needs to bring its cost per available seat kilometre below its revenue per available seat kilometre, with operating costs currently exceeding revenue

articles.headline: Jensen Huang returns as NVIDIA chief amid ongoing regulatory scrutiny
articles.title: Huang’s return restores stability, but NVIDIA faces years of scrutiny, warns Gartner
articles.summary: Jensen Huang returned as Chief Executive Officer at NVIDIA, restoring leadership stability after a period of turbulence. Gaurav Gupta from Gartner warned that the chipmaker still faces prolonged geopolitical scrutiny, legal risks, and demands for formal contracts from partners. The episode highlights the necessity for enterprise customers to diversify technology stacks and reduce their dependence on individual corporate hardware vendors.
articles.description: In an exclusive conversation with The Hindu, Mr.Gupta noted that the leadership turbulence has permanently altered NVIDIA’s operational landscape, leaving the company exposed to legal, regulatory, and commercial headwinds.

articles.headline: BP partners with Wipro to transform global finance operations
articles.title: BP ropes in Wipro to transform its core finance operations
articles.summary: British energy major BP entered into a strategic partnership with Wipro to transform core finance operations and improve cost competitiveness. Approximately three thousand BP employees across India, Hungary, and Malaysia will transition to Wipro. The information technology services provider will deploy artificial intelligence and automation technologies to streamline processes and deliver measurable business outcomes under the new agreement.
articles.description: Under this collaboration, around 3,000 bp employees supporting finance operations across India, Hungary and Malaysia would transition to Wipro

articles.headline: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment
articles.title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat
articles.summary: The Western Cape High Court in South Africa has declared an independent panel report concerning President Cyril Ramaphosa unlawful and set it aside entirely. Judge Nolwazi Mabindla-Boqwana ruled that the panel misconstrued its function regarding the theft of five hundred eighty thousand dollars at the Phala Phala farm. This legal victory removes the basis for parliamentary impeachment proceedings.
articles.description: The break-in happened in 2020, when thieves allegedly stole bundles of US dollar bills hidden inside a sofa at the farm.

articles.headline: India permits duty free raw sugar imports until March 2027
articles.title: Duty-free raw sugar imports up to 10 lakh tonnes allowed till March 2027
articles.summary: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade announced that duty free imports of up to ten lakh tonnes of raw sugar are permitted until the end of March 2027 under the Tariff Rate Quota scheme. According to the Indian Sugar and Bio Energy Manufacturers Association, price parity made sourcing from international markets viable. The policy aims to ensure adequate domestic supply and price stability.
articles.description: The industry expects more imports in the coming days and this will ensure supply of adequate quantity of sugar in the domestic market throughout the sugar season.

articles.headline: Hand of man facing murder charge severed in Pune court complex attack
articles.title: Hand of man facing murder charge severed in Pune court complex attack
articles.description: While the attackers fled, police recovered two pistols and a magazine from the spot, says an official

articles.headline: Amazon discusses potential integration of Meta's Muse AI
articles.title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
articles.summary: Amazon is reportedly negotiating with Meta to allow the Muse AI shopping agent on its marketplace. The discussions focus on how AI-driven product recommendations might affect advertising revenue and customer relationships. While other retailers have adopted similar AI tools, Amazon has previously blocked them to prioritize its own Alexa for Shopping assistant service instead.
articles.description: Amazon has held talks about letting Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its online marketplace, according to a report from Fortune. The discussions, which could end Amazon's block on Muse, reportedly center on the kinds of products the AI agent recommends and the potential impact on the ecommerce giant's advertising revenue. As reported by Fortune, […]

articles.headline: Andhra’s revenue rises 18.7% to ₹74,342 crore; Naidu asks officials to raise more without burdening people
articles.title: Andhra’s revenue rises 18.7% to ₹74,342 crore; Naidu asks officials to raise more without burdening people
articles.description: The State has achieved 58% of its annual own-revenue target of ₹1,27,506 crore, officials tell the Chief Minister

articles.headline: Drought threat looms over Keralam as 27 rainfall stations cross Trigger-1 drought threshold
articles.title: Drought threat looms over Keralam as 27 rainfall stations cross Trigger-1 drought threshold
articles.description: As per disaster management authority assessment, the State is likely to face a significant reduction in water availability during the upcoming summer, driven by the failure of both the southwest and northeast monsoons. The evolving situation points to the possibility of early summer-like conditions setting in across Keralam as early as the end of January 2027

articles.headline: IIT Dharwad scientist helps unravel structure of protein linked to heart disease
articles.title: IIT Dharwad scientist helps unravel structure of protein linked to heart disease
articles.description: The finding by an international team of researchers led by Badri Nath Dubey can help advance research into potential drug targets

articles.headline: Ibisbill survival highlights severe ecological threats facing Himalayan river systems
articles.title: A rare bird on stony rivers shows why Himalayan water needs its sediment
articles.summary: The ibisbill bird relies on the stony rivers of the Himalaya and Tibetan Plateau for feeding and breeding. According to geologist Parv Kasana from the Union Ministry of Earth Sciences, climate change and mining are destabilizing these vital waterways through increased glacier melt and erratic flows. Protecting the vulnerable avian species on November 26, 2026, is essential for preserving fragile ecosystems and critical regional water sources.
articles.description: The Himalayan rivers are home to several species that depend on rivers and their ecosystems, including fish, aquatic invertebrates like stonefly larvae and mayfly nymphs, and flora such as Himalayan alder and sea buckthorn along the banks and on the floodplains. When a river changes, all these environs, and their species, change as well

articles.headline: Music gear manufacturers embrace open source amid rise of AI modding
articles.title: Has vibe coding made open source the new normal for synths?
articles.summary: Music technology companies are increasingly releasing open-source tools and firmware to accommodate the growing trend of AI-assisted hardware modification. While brands like Akai and Polyend are actively supporting the modding community, others like Elektron remain cautious, citing potential device damage. Industry leaders suggest this shift may offer a more sustainable alternative to purchasing multiple devices.
articles.description: The emergence of powerful vibe-coding agents and tools like Reverse Engineer Anything has caused chaos in the music gear world, leaving companies scrambling to figure out how to respond. While some, like Roland, have remained silent for now, others have embraced the modding community. In the last several weeks, as it's become clear that no […]

articles.headline: Donald Trump to meet Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed on healthcare
articles.title: Trump to meet Abdul El-Sayed: Will he agree to a renamed Medicare-for-all?
articles.summary: President Donald Trump plans to meet Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed to discuss a potential universal healthcare plan. El-Sayed proposed renaming the Democratic "Medicare for All" initiative to "Trumpcare" to gain the president's support. Despite previous campaign rhetoric, Trump expressed interest in the proposal, while the White House continues to navigate potential negotiations regarding national insurance coverage.
articles.description: Weeks after a bitter Senate race in Michigan, US president calls Democratic victor ‘a smart guy’.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich confirms Musiala's neurological symptoms began in April
articles.title: Bayern Munich’s Musiala checked for neurological symptoms in April 2025
articles.summary: Bayern Munich announced that midfielder Jamal Musiala was first examined for neurological symptoms on April 22, 2025, months before his formal diagnosis in August. The club held discussions with Musiala's management following public speculation regarding his future. Both parties stated that the player's health remains the priority as he continues his recovery from the condition.
articles.description: Musiala was examined by the German club for neurological dysfunction after the initial onset of symptoms in 2025.

articles.headline: Kilmar Abrego Garcia leaves United States for Spain
articles.title: Kilmar Ábrego García arrives in Spain, ending Trump deportation battle
articles.summary: Kilmar Abrego Garcia is leaving the United States for Spain on a commercial flight following a prolonged deportation battle with the Trump administration. After being wrongfully deported to El Salvador in 2025 and later returned to face dropped human trafficking charges, his attorney stated that his departure is temporary while he waits out the end of the current administration.
articles.description: His deportation to and return from El Salvador became a flashpoint in the debate the US president's immigration agenda.

articles.headline: Union Cabinet approves new airport construction in Silchar for ₹2,014 crore
articles.title: Cabinet clears construction of new airport at Silchar for ₹2,014 crore
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a proposal to build a new airport at Doloo in Silchar, Assam, at an estimated cost of ₹2,014 crore. The project, fully funded by the Airports Authority of India, aims to handle 1.01 million passengers annually. Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated the facility will improve connectivity to the Barak Valley and promote regional tourism.
articles.description: The existing Silchar airport, owned by the Indian Air Force and the Airports Authority of India (AAI), operates a civil enclave spread over 70 acres

articles.headline: Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont plans return to Spain
articles.title: Catalan separatist Puigdemont to return to Spain on December 12
articles.summary: Former Catalan regional leader Carles Puigdemont announced he will return to Spain on December 12, ending years of self-imposed exile in Belgium. The move follows a Supreme Court decision to drop criminal charges against him under a new amnesty law. Puigdemont intends to present a renewed independence proposal to the Catalan Parliament on December 17.
articles.description: Former regional leader says he will unveil his proposal for a renewed Catalan independence push on December 17.

articles.headline: Veteran Nigerian actor Pete Edochie dies at age 79
articles.title: Veteran Nigerian Nollywood actor Pete Edochie dies aged 79
articles.summary: Renowned Nollywood actor Pete Edochie has died in Enugu at age 79 following a battle with prostate cancer. A foundational figure in the Nigerian film industry, Edochie gained international fame for his role in the 1987 adaptation of Things Fall Apart. He was celebrated for his commanding screen presence and contributions to preserving Igbo traditions.
articles.description: Odochie rose to prominence in 1987 after starring in a television adaptation of Chinua Achebe's acclaimed novel Things Fall Apart.

articles.headline: Bangladesh garment workers protest over new wages
articles.title: Bangladesh garment workers protest over new wages
articles.description: Bangladesh has raised the minimum monthly wage for garment workers by 36% to 17,000 taka, about $138.

articles.headline: Lakshmi Venu files lawsuit demanding partition of family business assets
articles.title: Lakshmi Venu files suit for partition of Venu Srinivasan family assets
articles.summary: Lakshmi Venu initiated legal action at the Madras High Court to partition joint family assets belonging to the Venu Srinivasan branch of the TVS family. The filing follows a November notice after amicable discussions failed. Her mother, Mallika Srinivasan, expressed support for equal shares. The branch controls TVS Motor Company, currently headed by her younger brother Sudarshan Venu.
articles.description: The suit follows her partition notice of November 16, 2026

articles.headline: Fire breaks out following drone strikes on a residential area in Al Damazin
articles.title: Fire breaks out following drone strikes on a residential area in Al Damazin
articles.description: Flames seen engulfing a house in Sudan’s Blue Nile state, following a large-scale drone strike carried out by the RSF.

articles.headline: AstroTalk denies using app data for user profiling or credit assessment
articles.title: AstroTalk says app data collection is for ‘security’, denies profiling users
articles.summary: AstroTalk, an online astrology platform, stated that information collected about installed Android applications is used solely for security purposes. This follows allegations from content creator Prathamesh Bhosle, who claimed the app tracks 244 specific programs to build user profiles. The company denied these claims, noting that data is not used for creditworthiness or behavioural profiling.
articles.description: A senior executive tells The Hindu that information about 244 applications installed on customers’ phones is not used to assess their creditworthiness; allegations raise questions about the platform’s data collection practices

articles.headline: Jannik Sinner faces uncertainty for Australian Open after knee surgery
articles.title: Sinner uncertain for Australian Open after undergoing knee surgery
articles.summary: Tennis star Jannik Sinner underwent minor surgery on his right knee in Finland, casting doubt on his participation in the Australian Open this January. Specialists suggest a recovery period of at least three to four months, potentially delaying his return until the American hard-court season. Sinner has not competed since winning Wimbledon in July.
articles.description: The five-time Grand Slam champion has not played a match since winning Wimbledon in July.

articles.headline: Indian urban planners adopt hostile architecture to deter wildlife from public spaces
articles.title: Hostile architecture: the design choices keeping wildlife out of urban India
articles.summary: Indian urban centers are increasingly utilizing hostile architecture elements such as wall spikes, balcony nets, and sloped structures to prevent animals and birds from entering human zones. Shilpa Shirish from the Bengaluru-based Indian Institute of Human Settlements noted on November 26, 2026, that these deterrents and modern construction materials actively exclude wildlife as shrinking green spaces force animals into closer contact with expanding urban developments.
articles.description: For animals and birds in India’s urban areas, hostile architecture takes many forms. ‘From spikes on ledges and nets over balconies to broken glass or spikes on compound walls that prevent animals from entering or perching,’ Shilpa Shirish, who specialises in culturally sensitive design at the Indian Institute of Human Settlements, Bengaluru, said

articles.headline: FSSAI launches nationwide packaged drinking water inspection and testing drive
articles.title: FSSAI’s pan-India enforcement drive on packaged drinking water, lab test to take 1-2 months: CEO
articles.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India initiated a pan-India enforcement drive to collect and test packaged drinking water samples following safety violations detected in Bisleri products. Chief Executive Officer Rajit Punhani stated that laboratory results would take up to two months, while the regulator also prepares to inspect food packaging materials to ensure compliance with established safety standards.
articles.description: The regulator has widened the scope of its scrutiny after a sample of Bisleri packaged drinking water failed the lab test

articles.headline: ‘People are going hungry’: Guinea’s gold mining crackdown
articles.title: ‘People are going hungry’: Guinea’s gold mining crackdown
articles.description: ‘People are going hungry’: Guinea’s gold mining crackdown

articles.headline: Udhayanidhi Stalin petitions police for Tamil Nadu legislator arrests
articles.title: Udhayanidhi Stalin submits petition to Tamil Nadu DGP demanding arrest of Kallakurichi and Thuraiyur TVK MLAs
articles.summary: Opposition leader Udhayanidhi Stalin submitted a petition at the Tamil Nadu Director General of Police office in Chennai, demanding the immediate arrest of Kallakurichi legislator C. Arul Vignesh and action against Chief Secretary M. Sai Kumar. The petition called for a Central Bureau of Investigation probe into alleged harassment and assault cases involving regional politicians, criticising authorities for significant delays in registering formal complaints.
articles.description: The DMK leader’s petition also seeks transfer of the probe to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and inquiry into the Chief Secretary’s failure to act on a woman IAS officer’s complaint dated July 31, 2026.

articles.headline: Kawasaki commits up to ₹800 crore for Karnataka facility expansion
articles.title: Karnataka CM in Japan: Kawasaki to invest up to ₹800 crore in State over 10 years
articles.summary: Japanese industrial firm Kawasaki Heavy Industries committed to invest up to eight hundred crore rupees over a decade to expand its manufacturing facility at the Harohalli Industrial Area in Karnataka. The agreement, signed in Tokyo in the presence of Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar, aims to boost production of hydraulic pumps and create approximately six hundred manufacturing jobs within the state's capital goods sector.
articles.description: Expansion of Harohalli plant to create 600 jobs; Chief Minister-led delegation also holds talks with Panasonic Automotive

articles.headline: Madras High Court told no official complaint received against Kallakurichi MLA
articles.title: T.N. Chief Secretary did not receive complaint from woman IAS officer over Kallakurichi TVK MLA’s alleged misbehaviour, Madras HC told
articles.summary: State Public Prosecutor R. John Sathyan informed the Madras High Court on November 23, 2026, that neither the Chief Secretary nor the police received any representation from a woman Indian Administrative Service officer regarding alleged misconduct by Kallakurichi legislator C. Arun Vignesh. Justice V. Lakshminarayanan directed the prosecution to verify directly with the official by November 24 before proceeding with the petition.
articles.description: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan asks State Public Prosecutor R. John Sathyan to take instructions from the woman officer, too, and report to the court by November 24, 2026

articles.headline: DGP says 30 Reasi terrorists exfiltrated to Pakistan for arms training
articles.title: 30 missing terrorists from Reasi exfiltrated to Pakistan for arms training, disturb peace in India: DGP
articles.summary: Director General of Police Nalin Prabhat reported that 30 terrorists from Reasi district, missing since 1991, have crossed into Pakistan. These individuals are allegedly working for Hizbul Mujahideen to supply arms and funds to revive terrorism in Jammu and Kashmir. Police have filed cases under the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act and seized land belonging to identified suspects.
articles.description: The police chief said Mahore Police Station received information through reliable sources that 30 terrorists hailing from Mahore and Chassana, missing since 1991 to 2003, had crossed over to Pakistan

articles.headline: Report finds over one-third of UK Muslim students experience Islamophobia
articles.title: ‘We need to be seen’: Over a third of UK Muslim students face Islamophobia
articles.summary: A survey by the Federation of Student Islamic Societies found that 38 percent of Muslim students in the United Kingdom have faced Islamophobia at university. The report, based on 715 respondents, highlights that women are disproportionately targeted. FOSIS is urging institutions to adopt formal definitions of Islamophobia and improve reporting systems to ensure greater accountability.
articles.description: From being spat on and assaulted to suffering humiliation, Muslims on campus are increasingly vulnerable, report says.

articles.headline: Samajwadi party names five assembly election candidates in Uttar Pradesh
articles.title: Samajwadi Party reveals 5 candidates for Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections
articles.summary: The Samajwadi Party announced five candidates on Tuesday for the two thousand twenty-seven Uttar Pradesh Assembly polls, naming Ashu Malik for Saharanpur, Nahid Hasan for Kairana, Mahboob Ali for Amroha, Jyoti Lodhi for Lalitpur, and Umar Ali Khan for Behat. Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav urged Congress to pursue seat adjustments and engage in serious discussions to defeat the Bharatiya Janata Party and ensure alliance victory.
articles.description: SP president Akhilesh Yadav urged Congress to understand public expectations and realities and engage in serious discussions to ensure victory for their alliance in most seats

articles.headline: Protesters demand release of detained Palestinian student in Jerusalem
articles.title: Protesters call on Israel to free Palestinian student held without charge
articles.summary: Supporters including students and academics demonstrated outside the Jerusalem District Court demanding the immediate release of Mahdi Tunsi, a twenty six year old sociology student at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem. Israeli police arrested him regarding ties to terrorism and requested administrative detention. Critics condemn the practice as indefinite detention without charge while authorities defend it as a security measure.
articles.description: Mahdi Tunsi, 26, was taken from his university dormitory earlier this month and has since been held without charge.

articles.headline: Iran implements rolling power cuts amid escalating economic crisis and sanctions
articles.title: Iran rations electricity: How deeply are US sanctions, blockade biting?
articles.summary: Iranian authorities imposed rolling power cuts lasting about two hours daily beginning Sunday due to a severe energy crisis compounding the country's economic battering. According to officials including government spokeswoman Fatemeh Mohajerani, gas shortages could reach 430 million cubic metres daily this winter. The economic fallout includes inflation averaging 76.8 percent and hundreds of thousands of job losses.
articles.description: Iran, a major oil producer, is facing a worsening energy crisis as winter looms.

articles.headline: Artificial intelligence tools strain local government public records systems across the US
articles.title: AI is straining America’s open records systems
articles.summary: Local government offices across the United States are struggling to handle a surge in public records requests driven by commercial data brokers and AI tools. Venture-backed startups have raised millions to collect government data for commercial sales signals, while individuals use generative AI to draft broader inquiries. This increased volume has overwhelmed municipal staff, prompting some states to consider legislation making it easier to deny requests.
articles.description: In Panton, Vermont, population 660, town clerk Kyle Rowe did it all. He crafted budgets, paid vendors, handled property tax disputes, and served as the town’s zoning supervisor and presiding elections officer. During morning office hours at the town hall—a wood-frame structure built as a church in 1858—he also fielded public records requests. Recently, he…

articles.headline: Libyan naval officers die following Ukrainian drone attack on Russian vessel
articles.title: Two Libyan soldiers die after Ukraine attack on Russian vessel
articles.summary: Two naval officers of the self-styled Libyan National Army died from wounds sustained during a Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian warship near Benghazi port. The officers were identified as Al-Taher Abdullah al-Sadiq and Lieutenant Ali Mohammed al-Said. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed Kyiv carried out the operation using seven naval drones, prompting the eastern-based Libyan government to seek an international investigation at the United Nations.
articles.description: Khalifa Haftar’s Libyan National Army, which Russia backs, vowed retaliation for the death of its soldiers

articles.headline: Air passenger services record highest inflation rate in second quarter
articles.title: Air passenger services see 35% inflation in Q2; banking, securities transaction witness deflation
articles.summary: Air passenger services recorded an inflation rate of 35.52 percent in the July-September quarter, the highest among seven major services tracked by provisional Service Producer Price Indices released on November 25, 2026. Conversely, securities transaction services and banking services witnessed deflations of 6.93 percent and 3.96 percent respectively. The Commerce and Industry Ministry data covers sectors with a 2022-23 base year.
articles.description: The Commerce and Industry Ministry released the provisional Service Producer Price Indices (PPI) for the second quarter of 2026-27

articles.headline: Kerala High Court extends stay on probe against Pinarayi Vijayan
articles.title: CMRL-Exalogic payoff case: Kerala HC extends stay on probe against Pinarayi Vijayan, kin
articles.summary: The Kerala High Court has extended the interim stay on an investigation and First Information Report involving Kerala Leader of Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan and his relatives in the CMRL-Exalogic payoff case. Justices Devan Ramachandran and V.M. Syam Kumar adjourned the hearing to December 15. The accused challenged a Single Bench order that directed registration of the FIR based on Enforcement Directorate information.
articles.description: Court was considering appeals by Vijayan, daughter T. Veena and son-in-law and former Public Works Minister P.A. Mohamed Riyas against a Single Bench order, directing registration of FIR

articles.headline: Supreme Court to hear INDIA bloc application over electoral roll revision
articles.title: Why has the INDIA bloc posed 48 questions to the Election Commission over SIR?
articles.summary: The Supreme Court decided to hear an application from Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance leaders, including Lok Sabha opposition figure Rahul Gandhi, seeking permission to submit forty eight interrogatories to the Election Commission of India. The legal challenge targets the nationwide Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, demanding clarification on authorisation procedures, digital system modifications, and collective decision making processes.
articles.description: Through the interrogatories, the petitioners want the decision making process to be made public

articles.headline: D. Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov draw opening game of World Chess Championship
articles.title: World Chess Championship: I thought I was always under control in the game, says Gukesh
articles.summary: Defending champion D. Gukesh secured a draw with black pieces against challenger Javokhir Sindarov in the opening game of the World Chess Championship in Geneva on Wednesday. Despite experiencing time trouble while using the Berlin Defence against the Ruy Lopes opening, Gukesh maintained control of the board. Sindarov noted he attempted to push for an advantage on the clock, but his opponent defended well.
articles.description: “Of course, I was trying to push every moment because of the clock, but I knew the position was very close to equal,” said Sindarov

articles.headline: Rising prices push families to the brink in Hodeidah, Yemen
articles.title: Rising prices push families to the brink in Yemen’s Hodeidah
articles.summary: Families in Hodeidah are struggling with basic goods as renewed fighting and inflation worsen economic hardship across Yemen. According to the Yemen Joint Monitoring Report, basic food baskets cost seven percent more in September than in August. Furthermore, the World Food Programme stated that fighting has cut off access to hundreds of thousands of people.
articles.description: Renewed fighting, rising fuel costs and shrinking incomes deepen the struggle to survive in the Houthi-controlled city.

articles.headline: Congress criticises Modi government over failure to secure delimitation majority
articles.title: ‘Saam, daam, dand, bhed’: Congress’ swipe at Modi Govt over delimitation issue
articles.summary: Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh criticised the Modi administration on Wednesday, alleging that the ruling leadership attempted to secure a two-thirds majority in the Lok Sabha for delimitation bills using financial inducements, institutional pressure and division. Ramesh stated that the government ignored repeated written proposals from Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge to pursue alternative dialogue methods instead.
articles.description: The Congress had earlier claimed that the continued suspense over the Parliament session suggested that either the "PM-HM jodi" is being trapped by its own bluff and bluster or something "truly sinister" is in the works

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu plans over 70 investment MoUs worth 50,000 crore rupees
articles.title: Tamil Nadu government set to ink 70 MoUs for investments to the tune of over ₹50,000 crore
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu is preparing to sign more than seventy memoranda of understanding worth over fifty thousand crore rupees during an investment conclave in Chennai. According to officials, the agreements span multiple sectors including clean energy, manufacturing, and aerospace. Industries Minister S. Keerthana stated that the administration prioritizes practical execution and balanced industrial growth across the state.
articles.description: Sources said the MoUs would cover sectors including manufacturing, clean energy, textiles, aerospace and defence

articles.headline: Congress criticizes government over malnutrition and anaemia survey report
articles.title: Where is the accountability: Kharge slams Modi govt on anaemia report
articles.summary: The Congress party criticized the central administration regarding a national report on malnutrition and anaemia. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge questioned government accountability, citing findings that more than half of women of reproductive age are anaemic. Meanwhile, research data released by the Indian Council of Medical Research showed that overall severe anaemia rates remain below two percent.
articles.description: The Modi government's emphasis on "mild" anaemia cannot obscure the fact that nearly 30% of women of reproductive age suffer from moderate or severe anaemia, the Congress chief said

articles.headline: Calcutta High Court halts Kolkata municipal polls over delimitation challenge
articles.title: Calcutta High Court restrains KMC polls until challenge on delimitation decided
articles.summary: The Calcutta High Court barred the West Bengal State Election Commission from issuing election notifications for the Kolkata Municipal Corporation based on newly redrawn wards. The ruling responds to a legal challenge filed by former councillor Dipu Das against the delimitation exercise. Judges concluded that the petitioner established a strong prima facie case to prevent the matter from becoming infructuous.
articles.description: The West Bengal government, through a delimitation, has increased the number of wards of KMC from 144 to 209. The petitioner argued that the State government and its agencies have resorted to gerrymandering in order to secure partisan advantage to the ruling political party in West Bengal on the premise of previous electoral results.

articles.headline: Rescuers search for twenty-six trapped miners in flooded Indonesian gold mine
articles.title: Rescuers search for dozens trapped in flooded Indonesia gold mine
articles.summary: Emergency personnel are searching for twenty-six workers trapped inside an unauthorized open-pit gold mine in Indonesia's West Java province. Police stated that heavy downpours caused a nearby river to overflow and flood the hundred-metre deep shaft in the Bogor district on Monday. Head of the Jakarta Search and Rescue Office Desiana Kartika Bahari noted that narrow access and limited lighting complicate operations.
articles.description: Police say 26 workers are yet to be rescued from a mine that flooded when a nearby river overflowed after heavy rain.

articles.headline: Jharkhand assembly opens special session as finance minister moves resolution against voter roll revision
articles.title: Jharkhand Assembly’s special session starts; Finance Minister moves resolution against SIR
articles.summary: Jharkhand finance minister Radha Krishna Kishore moved a resolution during a two-day special assembly session on November 25, 2026, demanding an immediate halt to the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Kishore alleged procedural complexities and stated that twenty-seven percent of voters received notices, accusing the Election Commission of India of acting as a central puppet. The resolution will be forwarded to central authorities upon approval.
articles.description: During the session, the House will deliberate on the special intensive revision (SIR) exercise and the amended mines law that was passed in Parliament in August

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu police register FIR against TVK MLA C. Arul Vignesh
articles.title: FIR registered against Kallakurichi TVK MLA for ‘misbehaving’ with woman IAS officer, Madras High Court told
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu police informed the Madras High Court on November 24, 2026, that an FIR was filed against Kallakurichi Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA C. Arul Vignesh for allegedly misbehaving with a woman Indian Administrative Service officer. Justice V. Lakshminarayanan directed the Chief Secretary to form an Internal Complaints Committee under the POSH Act to investigate the incident.
articles.description: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan orders that Tiruppur Superintendent of Police Shristi Singh shall be the investigating officer and IGP N. Kamini shall monitor the probe

articles.headline: Congress schedules nationwide constitution day marches to protest electoral roll irregularities
articles.title: Congress to hold ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches across States on Constitution Day, Kharge to join programme in Lucknow
articles.summary: The Indian National Congress announced nationwide Samvidhan Raksha Marches for November 26, 2026, to protest alleged electoral roll manipulation and the Election Commission of India. AICC general secretary K.C. Venugopal stated that party president Mallikarjun Kharge will attend the Lucknow event, while workers execute the Vote Rakshak campaign to help deleted voters. Leaders highlighted concerns over millions of voter deletions during the Special Intensive Revision process.
articles.description: The marches will begin at statues of Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, followed by a reading of the Preamble and an oath to protect the Constitution

articles.headline: Ownership and succession disputes emerge within Venu Srinivasan family over TVS holdings
articles.title: Ownership issues cloud TVS’ Venu Srinivasan, family
articles.summary: Succession and ownership differences have surfaced within the family of Venu Srinivasan involving Mallika Srinivasan, Lakshmi Venu, and Sudarshan Venu regarding TVS Motor Company and TVS Holdings Limited. Disclosures from April 2025 revealed that Sudarshan Venu was named a Significant Beneficial Owner through family trusts. The involved individuals represent third and fourth generation members of founder T.V. Sundaram Iyengar family.
articles.description: Sudarshan Venu, the 37-year-old CMD of TVS Motor Company, named as Significant Beneficial Owner (SBO) sets cats among pigeons

articles.headline: Shiromani Akali Dal and Bharatiya Janata Party reunite ahead of Punjab assembly elections
articles.title: NDA-SAD reunion: Why the Akali Dal severed ties with BJP 6 years ago
articles.summary: The Shiromani Akali Dal and the Bharatiya Janata Party have reunited ahead of the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections, six years after parting ways over opposition to three central farm laws. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other leaders defended the partnership, while opposition figures from Congress and the Aam Aadmi Party criticized the move as political opportunism. The alliance aims to help the Akali Dal rebuild its political base amidst shifting regional dynamics.
articles.description: Amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020

articles.headline: India faces renewed lumpy skin disease outbreak across multiple states
articles.title: The cow, the flea and the genome: One Health and the statecraft of prevention
articles.summary: India is experiencing a return of lumpy skin disease as early warning systems identified risks across twenty-eight states and Union territories. According to the Indian Council of Agricultural Research-National Institute of Veterinary Epidemiology and Disease Informatics, Rajasthan recorded over ten thousand cases in September. The resurgence highlights broader public health challenges linking animal, human, and environmental management.
articles.description: A cattle virus at home and a plague scare abroad make the same argument this World One Health Day: life is epidemiologically indivisible, and the institutions that govern and study it must learn to be so too

articles.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologises to staff and enters therapy amid falling share prices
articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he is in therapy as comeback rally fades
articles.summary: Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang admitted to making terrible mistakes during an all-hands meeting in Santa Clara, California, on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, revealing he is currently in therapy. His reinstatement following pressure from United States President Donald Trump failed to sustain a market rally, with shares falling six percent. The company faces multiple legal investigations and heightened congressional scrutiny.
articles.description: Jensen Huang told staff it was "not acceptable" that he had broken a code of conduct he had helped write, and dismissed suggestions that he was back because U.S. President Donald Trump had pressured the board

articles.headline: Gaza prisoners remain detained in Israel despite completing prison sentences
articles.title: Sentences served, but Gaza prisoners remain behind Israeli bars
articles.summary: Dozens of Palestinian prisoners from Gaza remain in Israeli custody after finishing their prison terms, according to the Palestinian Commission of Detainees and Ex-Detainees Affairs. Families report ongoing distress and a lack of communication since the war began. Human rights organisations and the United Nations have documented severe conditions and deaths in detention facilities throughout the ongoing conflict.
articles.description: Palestinian families in Gaza wait for loved ones who remain in Israeli prisons despite completing their sentences.

articles.headline: Indian equity indices Sensex and Nifty surge in early trade
articles.title: Sensex jumps over 2,000 points, Nifty surges to 25,951 on foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil
articles.summary: Benchmark equity indices Sensex and Nifty surged significantly in early trade on November 25, 2026, driven by strong foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, and buying in blue-chip bank stocks. The BSE Sensex jumped 1,382 points to reach 83,818.15, while the NSE Nifty rallied 407 points to 25,758.45, reflecting positive market momentum according to financial analysts.
articles.description: Stock markets were closed on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) on account of Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev.

articles.headline: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urges US to lift Cuba fuel blockade
articles.title: WHO chief calls on U.S. to lift oil blockade on Cuba, citing health impact
articles.summary: World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called on Tuesday for the immediate lifting of the United States fuel blockade on Cuba, warning that sanctions endanger children. During a three-day visit to Havana, Tedros announced a two million dollar contribution for immunization programs. Washington argues the sanctions push for political change, while Cuban authorities report severe daily power outages and medical shortages.
articles.description: United Nations has also repeatedly warned of a growing humanitarian crisis on the island, calling the U.S. fuel blockade a violation of international ‌law and the human rights of all ​Cubans

articles.headline: Bangladesh garment workers secure monthly wage increase following protests
articles.title: Bangladesh garment workers win 36% pay rise after weeks of protest
articles.summary: Bangladesh garment workers were offered a thirty-six percent minimum wage increase following months of demonstrations that caused substantial economic losses. The wage board announced the raise from twelve thousand five hundred taka to seventeen thousand five hundred taka, effective in December. While protesters had demanded a higher amount, labor representatives urged employees to return to factories despite lingering dissatisfaction.
articles.description: The protests have cost Bangladesh hundreds of millions, but workers are yet to accept the offer.

articles.headline: West Bengal infant denied birth certificate after father voter list deletion
articles.title: Infant denied birth certificate in West Bengal after father’s name deleted in SIR
articles.summary: A two-and-a-half-month-old infant in West Bengal’s Cooch Behar district was denied a birth certificate after her father, Abdul Habib, had his name removed from electoral rolls during a special intensive revision exercise. Local officials refused verification citing his citizenship status, though his appeal remains pending before a tribunal. The Association for Protection of Civil Rights condemned the administrative barrier as a violation of children's rights.
articles.description: There have been several instances in Bengal in the last few months in which the residents were denied basic facilities or access to a government scheme after their names were deleted in the SIR

articles.headline: India National Security Advisor Doval urges regional cooperation in Indian Ocean
articles.title: NSA Doval calls for closer regional security cooperation to counter challenges in Indian Ocean
articles.summary: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval stated on November 25, 2026, that India remains committed to enhancing collective security capacities with key Indian Ocean nations. Speaking at the eighth Colombo Security Conclave in Male, he emphasized deeper strategic cooperation to counter evolving transnational threats. The grouping comprises India, Sri Lanka, the Maldives, Mauritius, Bangladesh, and Seychelles, focusing on five maritime and counter-terrorism pillars.
articles.description: ‘The Colombo Security Conclave represents the intersection of our Neighbourhood First outlook and the MAHASAGAR vision,’ Ajit Doval said

articles.headline: Rajput leaders gather at Kunda religious event ahead of Uttar Pradesh elections
articles.title: Saffron stage, caste clout: Inside Kunda’s Rajput power play
articles.summary: Religious gatherings in Uttar Pradesh are increasingly serving as platforms for political messaging ahead of upcoming Assembly elections. During a recent Ram Katha in Kunda hosted by MLA Raghuraj Pratap Singh, prominent Rajput leaders and strongmen shared the stage to project unified caste strength and promote inclusive Hindutva slogans, alongside calls for Indian citizenship for Pakistani Hindu refugees.
articles.description: At the high-voltage Ram Katha, Raghuraj Pratap Singh sought to showcase Rajput clout within a broader majoritarian narrative ahead of assembly polls

articles.headline: Kerala chief minister rejects demand to lower teacher-student ratio
articles.title: LPST protest: Keralam CM Satheesan rules out lowering teacher-student ratio
articles.summary: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan stated on Wednesday that lowering the sanctioned teacher-student ratio from 1:30 to 1:25 in government lower primary schools in Kerala is impractical because the actual ratio has already fallen to 1:19 due to declining student enrollment. While the government agreed to four other demands from protesting rank-holders, Satheesan noted that appointments cannot be made to non-existent vacancies.
articles.description: CM says lowering teacher-student ratio from sanctioned 1:30 to 1:25 is ‘impractical' as the ratio is already down to 1:19 in government-run LP schools

articles.headline: Three people arrested after woman gang-raped at east Delhi cafe
articles.title: Woman gang-raped by colleagues at east Delhi cafe; three arrested
articles.summary: Delhi police arrested three individuals, including two women, following an alleged gang rape of a twenty-two-year-old woman at Saltanate Cafe in Preet Vihar. According to Deputy Commissioner of Police Rajeev Kumar, the victim and the six suspects worked together at another establishment and had gathered for drinks late Monday before returning to the closed cafe.
articles.description: Two women are among those held so far, while three others remain absconding; the victim and her colleagues had allegedly consumed alcohol at two locations in a late-night gathering before the incident

articles.headline: Cockroach Janta Party founder slams government over travel restriction
articles.title: Government fears that its failures will be exposed internationally: Dipke
articles.summary: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke criticised the Central government on Tuesday after co-founder Saurav Das was stopped at the Delhi airport and denied permission to travel to a university conference at Oxford in the United Kingdom. Dipke alleged the administration fears international exposure of its failures, while also announcing that his party will push for real youth issues during upcoming state elections.
articles.description: CJP founder slams Centre after Saurav Das was stopped from flying to U.K.

articles.headline: US intelligence agencies suffer cybersecurity breach of unclassified data
articles.title: U.S. CIA, ODNI suffer cybersecurity breach of some unclassified information, NYT reports
articles.summary: The United States Central Intelligence Agency and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence discovered a cybersecurity intrusion affecting an unclassified intelligence network. According to the New York Times, the November 24, 2026 breach also exposed information at other government agencies. The Office of the Director of National Intelligence reported zero disruptions to critical classified systems.
articles.description: While it was not clear specifically what unclassified material ​was compromised, information ‌at other government agencies was also believed to have been exposed in the breach

articles.headline: Karthigai deepam lit at traditional spot in Thirupparankundram hills
articles.title: Karthigai deepam lit only at traditional spot atop Thirupparankundram hills
articles.summary: The ceremonial lamp was lit exclusively at the traditional spot atop the Thirupparankundram hills on November 24, 2026, defying a Supreme Court direction for a limited one-time arrangement at a new location. Law Minister C.T.R. Nirmal Kumar stated the light was placed near the Uchchipillaiyar Temple. The decision sparked protests and subsequent police detentions of Bharatiya Janata Party leaders.
articles.description: Madurai Collector submitted before the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court that the administration was taking steps to comply with the Supreme Court order

articles.headline: SpiceJet operations shrink as active fleet drops to six aircraft
articles.title: With fleet down to six, SpiceJet flight services shrink to 20 per day
articles.summary: Embattled airline SpiceJet operates just over twenty flights daily with a reduced fleet of six aircraft, according to sources on November 24, 2026. Promoter Ajay Singh met Civil Aviation Ministry officials amid mounting passenger grievances and an ongoing show-cause notice issued by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation regarding rising cancellations and payment delays.
articles.description: According to the sources, SpiceJet promoter Ajay Singh met Ministry of Civil Aviation officials to update them on the airline’s situation

articles.headline: India and Nepal commence joint military exercise in Rupandehi district
articles.title: India-Nepal joint military exercise begins in Rupandehi
articles.summary: The 20th edition of the joint military training exercise named Abhyas Suryakiran began on Wednesday at the Nepal Army Battle School in Saljhandi, Rupandehi district. Involving battalion-level soldiers from both nations and running until December 8, the program focuses on exchanging experiences in disaster management, forest warfare, and humanitarian assistance to strengthen bilateral military relations.
articles.description: The exercise, involving battalion-level soldiers from the two countries, will run till December 8

articles.headline: D. Gukesh holds Javokhir Sindarov to draw in World Chess Championship opener
articles.title: World chess championship: Gritty Gukesh weathers time pressure, holds Sindarov
articles.summary: Grandmaster D. Gukesh secured a draw against Javokhir Sindarov using the Berlin Defence in the opening game of the World Chess Championship in Geneva on November 24, 2026. Gukesh managed severe time pressure during the 38-move encounter featuring a same-coloured-bishop ending. Both players praised the hard-fought contest that ended in a repetition of moves.
articles.description: The defending champion, who was battling the clock for most of the opening game, manages to salvage a draw

articles.headline: Indian women's hockey team climbs to fifth position in FIH rankings
articles.title: Indian women’s hockey team climbs to best-ever ranking of fifth in FIH chart
articles.summary: The Indian women's hockey team has reached fifth place in the international governing body rankings released on November 24, 2026, marking the squad's highest position since the system began in 2003. This advancement follows recent successes including a gold medal win at the Asian Games in Japan where the team defeated Olympic silver medallists China.
articles.description: In the rankings released by the FIH, the Netherlands were on top, followed by Argentina, Belgium and Spain

articles.headline: Real Madrid defeats PSV Eindhoven as Arsenal and Manchester City draw
articles.title: Champions League: Bellingham wondergoal helps Real Madrid thump PSV; Arsenal and Man City held
articles.summary: Real Madrid secured a 5-1 victory against PSV Eindhoven on November 24, 2026, maintaining a perfect start in the Champions League following goals from Federico Valverde, Jude Bellingham, Kylian Mbappe, and Vinicius Jr. Meanwhile, Premier League leaders Arsenal were held to a 1-1 draw by Borussia Dortmund, and Manchester City played out a 2-2 match against Napoli.
articles.description: Mbappe scores twice in Madrid’s 5-1 rout; Arsenal were held 1-1 at home by Borussia Dortmund and Manchester City drew ​2-2 with Napoli

articles.headline: North Korea expels senior Swiss diplomat and orders office closure
articles.title: North Korea declares a Swiss diplomat persona non grata and orders him to leave
articles.summary: North Korea declared Astier Sylvain, head of the newly opened Swiss diplomatic office in Pyongyang, persona non grata on November 25, 2026, demanding his departure within 48 hours. According to the Korean Central News Agency, the action followed Swiss sanctions imposed on the Songdowon International Children's Camp over the transfer of children from Russia-occupied areas of Ukraine.
articles.description: Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un,c ondemned Switzerland for imposing sanctions on a youth camp in eastern North Korea over its alleged role in the transfer of children from Russia-occupied areas of Ukraine

articles.headline: Defending champion D Gukesh draws opening game against Javokhir Sindarov
articles.title: World Chess Championship: Gukesh says preparation tougher than playing
articles.summary: Defending champion D Gukesh opened his World Chess Championship title defence with a 38-move draw playing with the black pieces against Javokhir Sindarov on November 25, 2026. Gukesh navigated severe time pressure during the match in Singapore, later stating that tournament preparation requires more effort than playing. Both players will return for the second game.
articles.description: The Indian, playing with the black pieces, will have the advantage of white in Wednesday's (November 25, 2026) second game
